feeds.title: Tobacco Control Blog
feeds.description: A space to discuss the wider issues of tobacco control beyond the journal. Covers articles on the Tobacco industry, Legislation & Policy, Advocacy, E-cigarettes, Framework Convention on Tobacco Control, Marketing/Advertising, WHO and more.Tobacco Control is an international peer-reviewed journal covering the nature and consequences of tobacco use worldwide.

feeds.title: Tobacco and Public Health Blog
feeds.description: Insights, analysis and commentary on tobacco control and commercial determinants of health from the Tobacco Control Research Group.Covers articles on Industry tactics, Research, Public health, Public policy, Child labour, Corporate Social Responsibility, Harm reduction, LMICs, Lobbying and Supply chains.The Tobacco Control Research Group (TCRG) was started by Professor Anna Gilmore in 2011.

feeds.title: Action on Smoking & Health Blog
feeds.description: Posts on innovative legal & policy measures to end the global tobacco epidemic. Action on Smoking and Health (ASH) envisions a world free of tobacco-related damage, disease and death. ASH works closely with its allies to ensure that the public health community addresses the tobacco epidemic in a unified and coherent manner.

feeds.title: The New York Times » Smoking and Tobacco
feeds.description: News about smoking and tobacco, including commentary and archival articles published in The New York Times.

feeds.title: New York Post » Tobacco
feeds.description: Get the latest tobacco news, articles, videos and photos on the New York Post. New York Post is your source for breaking news, photos, and videos about New York, sports, business, entertainment, opinion, real estate, culture, fashion, and more.

feeds.title: The Denver Post » Tobacco
feeds.description: Latest news on Tobacco. Read breaking stories and articles on tobacco at The Denver Post.

feeds.title: The Tobacco and Alcohol Research Group Blog
feeds.description: Get the latest updates on our research. Covers a range of topics such as Mental Health, Alcohol, Depression, E-cigarette, Policy, Smoking cessation and Tobacco industry.The Tobacco and Alcohol Research Group conducts research into the psychological and biological factors underlying health behaviours.

feeds.title: Tobacco Free Florida Blog
feeds.description: Read our fact-based blog about smoking cessation and more. Tobacco Free Florida is here to help you on your quit journey to living a smokefree life!

feeds.title: Tobacco Asia Magazine
feeds.description: Tobacco Asia Magazine is the leading tobacco Industry magazine for manufacturers of tobacco products and the leading wholesale/distribution trade. Reporting on equipment, machinery, supplies, services, tobacco leaf and tobacco products including cigarettes, e-cigarettes, cigars, Indonesia and China.

feeds.title: Tobacco 21
feeds.description: Tobacco 21 is a national campaign aimed at raising the minimum legal age for tobacco and nicotine sales in the United States to 21. The Tobacco 21 campaign is produced and funded by the Preventing Tobacco Addiction Foundation, a public health nonprofit organization established in 1996.

feeds.title: Tobacco Reporter
feeds.description: Since 1874, Tobacco Reporter has been the global source for what is happening in the industry. We are proud to continue a 150-year tradition of excellence with the current, monthly Tobacco Reporter, recognized as the leading trade journal around the world. The mission is to help readers succeed in their jobs by providing relevant, timely, and accurate information.

feeds.title: Keep It Sacred » Tobacco
feeds.description: We are a national network of Tribes, tribal organizations and health programs working to decrease commercial tobacco use and cancer health disparities among American Indians and Alaska Natives (AI/AN) across the U.S. We offer technical assistance, culturally relevant resources, and a place to share up-to-date information and lessons learned, as part of a community of tribal and tribal-serving public health programs. Explore the latest news in tobacco industry, reports and research and more!

feeds.title: The Continuum of Risk » Tobacco
feeds.description: A Law Blog for Vapor, Tobacco and Reduced-Harm Product Companies. The 'continuum of risk' is the scientific concept that not all tobacco and nicotine-delivering products are equally harmful. Indeed, while no tobacco product may be completely 'safe' it is important for businesses, researchers, and consumers to understand the idea of relative harm when it comes to tobacco and nicotine.

feeds.title: Eye on the Trails
feeds.description: Eye on the Trails is an information service on tobacco litigation in Canada. Read all the legal news and updates about tobacco and other substance use.

feeds.title: Capital District Tobacco-Free Communities Blog
feeds.description: Capital District Tobacco-Free Communities (CDTFC) is a program of St. Peter's Health Partners serving Albany, Rensselaer and Schenectady Counties, and funded by a grant from the New York State Department of Health as part of the NYS Tobacco Control Program. Explore the blog for all the latest news coverage and reports of tobacco on health, international research and more!

feeds.title: Stanton Glantz Blog » Tobacco Companies
feeds.description: Stanton Glantz retired from the University of California San Francisco faculty in September 2020, after 45 years on the faculty. Dr. Glantz continues to conduct research on a wide range of topics ranging from the health effects of e-cigarettes and secondhand smoke (with particular emphasis on the cardiovascular system) to the efficacy of different tobacco control policies. Check out his research on tobacco companies, reports and statistics and more!

feeds.title: The Rest of the Story: Tobacco and Alcohol News Analysis and Commentary
feeds.description: Dr Siegel is a visiting professor and researcher in the Department of Public Health and Community Medicine at the Tufts University School of Medicine. He previously spent two years working at the Office on Smoking and Health at CDC, where he conducted research on secondhand smoke and cigarette advertising. He has published nearly 70 papers related to tobacco. Explore his research, articles and finding on the tobacco and its effects.

feeds.title: Tobacco Law Blog
feeds.description: Troutman Pepper offers a unique and holistic legal approach to businesses in the tobacco industry. Our tobacco practice consists of partners, of counsel, associates, paralegals, and professional staff. Most of our tobacco lawyers have experience working in state Attorneys General offices. Our lawyers provide the government experience, legal skills and business savvy to best service our clients.

feeds.title: Education Against Tobacco Blog
feeds.description: Since 2012, Education Against Tobacco has grown as an international network to support informed decision-making of teens about the advantages of a life free of smoke.

feeds.title: Stopping Tobacco Organizations and Products
feeds.description: Stay up to date with the latest news on STOP and the tactics of the tobacco industry. STOP is a global tobacco industry watchdog dedicated to shining a light on the industry and strengthening health policy to save lives.
